145:     async def _check_dht_ready(self, min_dht_peers=60):
146:         # Checks whether we got enough DHT peers. If the number of DHT peers is low,
147:         # checking for a bunch of torrents in a short period of time may result in several consecutive requests
148:         # sent to the same peers. This can trigger those peers' flood protection mechanism,
149:         # which results in DHT checks stuck for hours.
150:         # See https://github.com/Tribler/tribler/issues/5319
151:         while not (self.get_session() and self.get_session().status().dht_nodes > min_dht_peers):
152:             await asyncio.sleep(1)
